_about: Each team's current standard home helmet, for the matchup art prompt. Keyed by the scoreboard's team display name. Only teams whose helmet is known with confidence are listed; any other team gets a generic phrase. CONFIG_DIR/art/helmets.json, in the same shape, is merged over this file (an empty string there removes a description). See docs/SPORTS_MATCHUP_CARDS.md.
